thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx and streaming disconnects on /v1/stream starting 3021122000 — error rate 5xx: 18% over 5m (baseline 0.3%). paging oncall-sre :rotating_light:

oncall-sre: got it. I'm looking at the gateway metrics now. can someone grab traces for affected requests?

dmitri: pulling traces — looks like many requests end with 'client cancelled' but a lot of 502/504 from gateway too. adding sampling.

carla: product reporting multiple customers seeing truncated streams and reconnect loops. ticket volume up 4x.

ben: customer-impact estimate: ~120 active streaming sessions dropped in last 10m across 3 tenants. throttles? quota?

elaine: checking infra — streaming-gateway pods CPU and network appear normal. but core-gateway shows increased 5xx 502s. routing logs show a flurry of upstream timeouts.

oncall-sre: can we confirm if it's upstream model hosts or edge? dmitri, can you tail gateway->runtime logs for a sample trace id: trace=9f3a2b?

 dmitri: tailing now. snippet from gateway log for trace 9f3a2b:
```
2026-03-15T18:12:05Z gateway stream_conn=abcd123 path=/v1/stream status=502 upstream=runtime-3 err="upstream read timeout"
2026-03-15T18:12:06Z gateway stream_conn=abcd123 chunk_write=partial client_cancel=true
```

carla: interesting — gateway is returning 502 then client reports cancel. could be gateway timing out waiting for backend chunked frames. any recent config changes to idle timeouts?

elaine: none in the last 24h. however, routing shows increased fanout to runtime-3 (one of the narrow-model hosts). load balancer shows ephemeral connection resets to that host.

oncall-sre: hypothesis: one runtime host is stalling on chunked encoding, causing gateway upstream timeouts which cascade to 502s and then clients cancelling. mitigation: take runtime-3 out of pool (drain) and see if errors drop.

 ben: +1 for targeted drain. we should also enable a temporary fallback to small-model-quantized variant to reduce latency for in-flight requests. can ops toggle routing flag?

elaine: initiating drain of runtime-3. marking as unhealthy in service discovery.

incident-bot: ACTION: runtime-3 marked draining by elaine at 3021122450

 dmitri: after drain started — observing initial drop in upstream timeouts. gateway 5xx rate down to 9% in the last 2m. client cancels still present but fewer.

carla: support-team-bot, please update impacted customer tickets with status: in mitigation, we have drained a problematic host and are monitoring.

support-team-bot: auto-note posted to tickets T-2345, T-2346, T-2351: "We detected streaming interruptions; engineering is mitigating by draining a host and monitoring. ETA 15-30m."

oncall-sre: running quick memory/FD checks on runtime-3 before we reprovision. logs show several stack traces in the streaming encoder around chunked flush path.

 dmitri: paste of suspicious runtime stack snippet:
```
panic: write after deadline
 goroutine 421 [running]:
 github.com/redwood/streaming.(*encoder).flush(encoder.go:248)
 github.com/redwood/streaming.(*session).writeLoop(session.go:102)
```

elaine: looks like a bug where a deadline error can leave the encoder in a bad state and block subsequent chunk flushes. runtime-3 likely hit this and stopped streaming, causing gateway timeouts.

carla: status update for exec: rollback not needed. mitigation path: 1) keep draining affected host(s), 2) bump gateway upstream timeout from 15s -> 25s temporarily to avoid transient 502s while we patch, 3) enable routing fallback to quantized small-model for heavy routes.

 oncall-sre: implementing gateway timeout bump on canary in us-east-1 now. will monitor error rate and latency.

incident-bot: CONFIG_CHANGE: gateway upstream_timeout set to 25s (canary us-east-1) by oncall-sre at 3021122710

 dmitri: deploying a hotfix branch that short-circuits encoder flush on deadline error and recovers session. patch pushed as runtime-hotfix-3021, preparing canary deploy to one host.

 ben: product: please prepare customer comms template for 30m and 2h updates. include cause (upstream host stall -> gateway timeouts), mitigation steps, and ETA for full fix.

carla: metrics now: 5xx back down to 2.1% in canary region, streaming client reconnects down 70%. ticket surge plateaued. good sign.

elaine: runtime-3 confirmed crashed gracefully after drain, core dump attached for postmortem. redeploying hotfix to replaced instance.

support-team-bot: customer note updated: "We mitigated the issue by removing a degraded host and deploying a fix; monitoring for full resolution."

oncall-sre: moving to recovery — keep watch on cross-region propagation. if stable for 45m we'll clear the page and open a postmortem. please log any related errors to this thread.

incident-bot: PAGE CLEAR: incident status moved to 'mitigation' by oncall-sre at 3021125934

carla: adding follow-ups: create postmortem, include stack trace above, verify encoder deadline handling with fuzzed chunk responses, and add alert for rising client-cancel ratio correlated with gateway 502s.

 dmitri: agreed. I'll own the runtime fix + tests. oncall-sre, please keep an eye overnight for recurrence.

oncall-sre: will do. thanks everyone — big help triaging quickly. :raised_hands:
